description: Cloud Streams gateway ingestion, broker delivery and HTTP server/client health, from the OpenTelemetry metrics exported over OTLP.

panels.description: Rate of cloud events accepted by the gateway(s) and appended to the event store (cloud_streams_gateway_events_ingested_count).
panels.title: Events ingested

panels.description: Rate of cloud events rejected by the gateway authorization policy (cloud_streams_gateway_events_rejected_count).
panels.title: Events rejected

panels.description: Rate of cloud events refused by gateway validation (cloud_streams_gateway_events_invalid_count).
panels.title: Events invalid

panels.description: Rate of cloud events successfully dispatched to subscribers (cloud_streams_broker_events_published_count).
panels.title: Events delivered

panels.description: Rate of failed dispatch attempts to subscribers (cloud_streams_broker_delivery_failures_count).
panels.title: Delivery failures

panels.description: Failed dispatch attempts / (successful dispatches + failed dispatch attempts) over the selected brokers, subscriptions and streams.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum(rate({__name__=~"cloud_streams_broker_delivery_failures_count.*", ${job_label}=~"$broker", subscription=~"$subscription", stream=~"$stream"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(rate({__name__=~"cloud_streams_broker_events_published_count.*", ${job_label}=~"$broker", subscription=~"$subscription", stream=~"$stream"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate({__name__=~"cloud_streams_broker_delivery_failures_count.*", ${job_label}=~"$broker", subscription=~"$subscription", stream=~"$stream"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)), 1e-9)

panels.title: Delivery failure ratio

panels.description: Ingested = accepted and appended to the event store; rejected = denied by the gateway authorization policy; invalid = refused by validation.
panels.title: Cloud events by admission outcome

panels.description: (rejected + invalid) / (ingested + rejected + invalid), per gateway.

targets.expr: label_replace(100 * (sum by (${job_label}) (rate({__name__=~"cloud_streams_gateway_events_(rejected|invalid)_count.*", ${job_label}=~"$gateway"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (${job_label}) (rate({__name__=~"cloud_streams_gateway_events_ingested_count.*", ${job_label}=~"$gateway"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / clamp_min(sum by (${job_label}) (rate({__name__=~"cloud_streams_gateway_events_(ingested|rejected|invalid)_count.*", ${job_label}=~"$gateway"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9), "service", "$1", "${job_label}", "(.*)")

panels.title: Admission refusal ratio

panels.description: HTTP requests served by the cloud event ingestion endpoint of the gateway, by response status code.
panels.title: Publish endpoint (POST api/events/pub) by status code

panels.description: Duration of the ingestion of cloud events, from their admission to their storage in the event store (cloud_streams_gateway_ingestion_duration), for the events that were stored.
panels.title: Ingestion latency

panels.description: Rate of cloud events refused by the gateway, per reason: rejected by the split-horizon or authorization policies, or invalid because of their attributes or of their data schema.
panels.title: Refused events by reason

panels.description: Rate of cloud events stored, and of admitted cloud events that could not be appended to the event store, per source. Past the first 100 distinct sources, sources are labelled 'other'.
panels.title: Ingested and failed events by source

panels.description: Rate of cloud events successfully dispatched, per subscription.
panels.title: Delivered events by subscription

panels.description: Rate of failed dispatch attempts (non-success status code or transport error), per subscription. Each failure puts the subscriber in the Unreachable state and triggers the retry policy.
panels.title: Delivery failures by subscription

panels.description: failures / (delivered + failures), per subscription. Only subscriptions with at least one failure in the window are shown.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (subscription) (rate({__name__=~"cloud_streams_broker_delivery_failures_count.*", ${job_label}=~"$broker", subscription=~"$subscription", stream=~"$stream"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (subscription) (rate({__name__=~"cloud_streams_broker_delivery_failures_count.*", ${job_label}=~"$broker", subscription=~"$subscription", stream=~"$stream"}[$__rate_interval])) + (sum by (subscription) (rate({__name__=~"cloud_streams_broker_events_published_count.*", ${job_label}=~"$broker", subscription=~"$subscription", stream=~"$stream"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (subscription) (rate({__name__=~"cloud_streams_broker_delivery_failures_count.*", ${job_label}=~"$broker", subscription=~"$subscription", stream=~"$stream"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0), 1e-9)

panels.title: Delivery failure ratio by subscription

panels.description: Delivery throughput and failures per source stream ('All' when the subscription is not partitioned).
panels.title: Delivered vs failed by stream

panels.description: Delivery throughput per broker instance (service name).
panels.title: Delivered events by broker

panels.description: Amount of records of its stream each subscription has yet to handle (cloud_streams_broker_subscription_lag), as reported by the broker replica that holds its lease.
panels.title: Lag by subscription

panels.description: Duration of delivery attempts, from the request to the subscriber's response, mutation included (cloud_streams_broker_delivery_duration), per outcome: delivered, deferred ('202 Accepted') or failed.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, outcome) (rate(cloud_streams_broker_delivery_duration_seconds_bucket{${job_label}=~"$broker", subscription=~"$subscription", stream=~"$stream"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, outcome) (rate(cloud_streams_broker_delivery_duration_seconds_bucket{${job_label}=~"$broker", subscription=~"$subscription", stream=~"$stream"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Delivery latency by outcome

panels.description: How long deferred acknowledgements have been pending before being acknowledged, negatively acknowledged or expiring (cloud_streams_broker_ack_duration).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, outcome) (rate(cloud_streams_broker_ack_duration_seconds_bucket{${job_label}=~"$broker", subscription=~"$subscription", stream=~"$stream"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, outcome) (rate(cloud_streams_broker_ack_duration_seconds_bucket{${job_label}=~"$broker", subscription=~"$subscription", stream=~"$stream"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Deferred acknowledgement duration by outcome

panels.description: Inbound HTTP requests per second, by method and route (ASP.NET Core http.server.request.duration).
panels.title: Gateway - request rate by route

panels.description: Inbound HTTP request duration percentiles across the selected instances.
panels.title: Gateway - request latency

panels.description: Share of inbound HTTP requests answered with a 4xx / 5xx status code.
panels.title: Gateway - error rate

panels.description: Inbound HTTP requests per second, by method and route (ASP.NET Core http.server.request.duration).
panels.title: Broker - request rate by route

panels.description: Inbound HTTP request duration percentiles across the selected instances.
panels.title: Broker - request latency

panels.description: Share of inbound HTTP requests answered with a 4xx / 5xx status code.
panels.title: Broker - error rate

panels.description: HTTP requests sent by the broker (subscriber dispatch; may also include other outbound HTTP/gRPC traffic - narrow it with the 'Destination' variable).
panels.title: Outbound requests by destination and status

panels.description: p50 / p95 / p99 of the broker's outbound HTTP request duration, per destination host.
panels.title: Outbound request latency by destination

panels.description: Share of outbound requests that failed (error_type set: 4xx/5xx status code, timeout, connection failure...), per destination host.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by (server_address) (rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{${job_label}=~"$broker", server_address=~"$server_address", error_type!=""}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (server_address) (rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{${job_label}=~"$broker", server_address=~"$server_address"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / clamp_min(sum by (server_address) (rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{${job_label}=~"$broker", server_address=~"$server_address"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Outbound error rate by destination

list.description: Label carrying the OpenTelemetry service.name. 'job' for Prometheus' native OTLP receiver, 'exported_job' when Prometheus scrapes an OpenTelemetry Collector prometheus exporter, 'service_name' when that resource attribute is promoted.
list.label: Service label
list.name: job_label
